parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with bulk_update() and F() expressions but may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change uses hasattr(attr, 'resolve_expression') which might inadvertently allow other objects with this method to be treated as expressions, potentially leading to unexpected behavior.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the fix or ensure that other types of expressions are handled correctly.
